$comment: SOURCE: the community 'best value attribute thresholds' sheet supplied by the repo owner names
four takeovers and their unlock ratings. Only those four are recorded. Takeovers that existed in
earlier 2K titles have been REMOVED rather than carried forward on assumption — if 2K27 has more
takeovers than these, they are simply missing, not absent from the game.
2K27 coverage also mentions a 'Hydration Hero' takeover ability relating to Adrenaline/Stamina
drain, which is consistent with Stamina being an in-game (Gatorade gym) stat rather than a
builder attribute. It has no known attribute requirement so it is not modelled here.
Tier structure (a single unlock vs unlock + upgrade) is UNVERIFIED; each takeover below has one

verification.notes: Number of takeover slots in 2K27 is unknown. 2K27 coverage mentions five ability slots, which may or may not be the same system.

verification.source: Best value attribute thresholds sheet: 'Driving Dunk 87 -> Contact Dunks, Silver Posterizer, Air Space Takeover' and 'Vertical 75 -> Air Space Takeover, Pro Contact Dunks, Silver Posterizer'.
